platforms.name: KTRU 96.1 Rice University Physical Music Submission Route
platforms.country: United States / Houston, Texas Rice University student-run freeform radio physical music-submission route
platforms.feeAmount: No submission fee is stated; physical media production and shipping costs remain with the sender.
platforms.manualReviewReason: KTRU explicitly accepts only physical music submissions in CD, LP or 7-inch format and publishes separate USPS and UPS addresses. A human must choose the carrier, verify the current addressing details, prepare the physical release and package, and may use the Music Director contact form only for questions rather than as a substitute for the physical route.
platforms.notes: The official KTRU contact and home pages were verified on 2026-07-11. The contact form includes a Music Director recipient option and the station states that all music submissions must use physical formats. Current activity is evidenced by station articles dated May 21 and June 3, 2026 and live setlist links. No form was submitted, no package was prepared and no contact probing was performed.

platforms.name: WCBN 88.3 University of Michigan Hard-Copy Music Submission Route
platforms.country: United States / Ann Arbor, Michigan University of Michigan student-run freeform radio hard-copy music-submission route
platforms.feeAmount: No submission fee is stated; physical media production and shipping costs remain with the sender.
platforms.manualReviewReason: WCBN accepts music from musicians who send a hard copy, preferably CD or vinyl, and asks genre-specific releases to be addressed care of the relevant director. A human must prepare the physical media, choose the appropriate genre destination, verify the mailing address and ship the package.
platforms.notes: The official WCBN contact page was verified on 2026-07-11. It says WCBN listens to all hard-copy releases received and publishes the WCBN MUSIC mailing address plus named 2025-2026 and 2026 board and department personnel. The Music Directors email link is protected/non-plaintext in the retrieved page and was not decoded or guessed. The station broadcasts 24/7 and exposes recent archives and current programming. No email was sent and no package was prepared.

platforms.name: WNUR 89.3 Northwestern General Manager Music Inquiry Route
platforms.country: United States / Evanston, Illinois Northwestern University student-run radio pre-submission inquiry route
platforms.feeAmount: No inquiry or submission fee is stated.
platforms.manualReviewReason: WNUR publishes gm@wnur.org and a general contact form but does not explicitly publish a music-submission policy, accepted formats, download-link rules or recipient for new releases. A human must send a limited pre-submission inquiry without attachments or music links and wait for authorization before delivering any material.
platforms.notes: The official WNUR contact and home pages were verified on 2026-07-11. The public business email gm@wnur.org and contact form are authorized for station questions, while music delivery permission is not stated. The site shows a July 8, 2026 schedule with Rock, Jazz, Handpicked and other programming. This record is therefore an inquiry opportunity, not an assumed submission route. No form or email was sent.

platforms.name: WNMC 90.7 Genre Music Director Contact-Form Route
platforms.country: United States / Traverse City, Michigan Northwestern Michigan College community radio genre-director contact route
platforms.feeAmount: No inquiry or submission fee is stated.
platforms.manualReviewReason: WNMC directs record companies and anyone contacting a Music Director to write through the Station Manager form, who forwards the message to the appropriate genre director. A human must select the best-fit director, prepare a concise rights-cleared inquiry, complete the public form and wait for delivery instructions before sending music.
platforms.notes: The official WNMC contact, station-manager form and home pages were verified on 2026-07-11. The site lists current Electronic, Reggae, World, Rock, Jazz, Blues and other Music Directors and publishes active schedules, current playlists and online listening. The form requests name, email, address and comments/questions; no login or visible CAPTCHA requirement was observed. No form was submitted and no files or links were supplied.

platforms.name: WTBU Boston University Music Directors Album Submission Email Route
platforms.country: United States / Boston, Massachusetts Boston University student-run college-radio album submission route
platforms.feeAmount: No submission fee is stated; editorial rotation consideration applies.
platforms.manualReviewReason: WTBU explicitly asks artists interested in sending an album to contact the Music Directors at wtbu.musicdirectors@gmail.com, but does not publish accepted audio formats, attachment limits, cloud-link rules, metadata fields, clean-edit requirements or release windows. A human must prepare the pitch, confirm the preferred package and avoid unrequested large attachments.
platforms.notes: The official WTBU contact and home pages were verified on 2026-07-11. The current staff page names two Music Directors, publishes wtbu.musicdirectors@gmail.com for album submissions and also exposes a general message form. The site shows music coverage dated May 20 and May 25, 2026 and active listening and schedule links. No email or form was sent and no deliverability probing was performed.
